ruleDefinitions.name: Atbroker Registry Change
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects creation/modification of Assistive Technology applications and persistence with usage of 'at' Note: Unmapped fields: Details

sequences.query: (registry_path = RGX(".*Software\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\ NT\\\\CurrentVersion\\\\Accessibility\\\\ATs.*") OR registry_path = RGX(".*Software\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\ NT\\\\CurrentVersion\\\\Accessibility\\\\Configuration.*")) AND  NOT ((process_path = "C\:\\Windows\\system32\\atbroker\.exe" AND registry_path = RGX(".*\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\ NT\\\\CurrentVersion\\\\Accessibility\\\\Configuration.*") AND Details = "\(Empty\)") OR (process_path = RGX("^C\\:\\\\Windows\\\\Installer\\\\MSI") AND registry_path = RGX(".*Software\\\\Microsoft\\\\Windows\\ NT\\\\CurrentVersion\\\\Accessibility\\\\ATs.*")))
